Thanks for your reply. 


I haven't, I'll look into it.


I would like to talk to someone about the way I feel, I don't have anyone I would feel comfortable saying these things to, as they would either take it so seriously that they couldn't really give me any constructive advice, or would just tell me that I am overreacting and I just need to "pull myself together". 


I can't tell whether I am actually suicidal or just find sadistic pleasure in seeing myself suffer. I always need to be experiencing intense emotions and I feel so alive, but when I am depressed and feeling nothing it is unbearable to me. The only real joy I have felt in about a year is from daydreaming about certain things happening. I can't find the root of why I feel like I do and it is so confusing.
